headline: Ether and DeFi Tokens Fall Twice as Fast as Bitcoin in Market Sell-Off
summary: Ether and decentralized finance tokens fell approximately twice as fast as bitcoin as a broader equity market sell-off resumed. Bitcoin dropped 1.2% since midnight UTC.
why: Cryptocurrencies frequently trade as risk-on assets correlated with high-beta equities, experiencing accelerated drawdowns during wider market risk-off events.

impacts.name: Ethereum
impacts.why: Widespread risk aversion in equity markets triggers liquidations and capital outflows from altcoins and DeFi tokens.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A resumption of equity market sell-offs spilled over into digital assets, triggering heavier losses in altcoins and DeFi tokens compared to bitcoin.
